name: AgentGuard Overview
description: Live view of AI coding agents: tool calls, detections, attack chains and baselines. Filter by deployment (dss-demo for the DSS 2026 demo).

panels.title: Active sessions (window)
panels.description: Distinct sessions with any event in the selected window. Streaming.
panels.viz_content: SELECT count_distinct(session_id) AS sessions FROM ag.agentguard_cim_event WHERE deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' SETTINGS seek_to = '-{{filter_time_range}}'

panels.title: Tool calls (window)
panels.description: tool_invoke events in the selected window. Streaming.
panels.viz_content: SELECT count() AS tool_calls FROM ag.agentguard_cim_event WHERE event_type = 'tool_invoke' AND deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' SETTINGS seek_to = '-{{filter_time_range}}'

panels.title: Open critical threats
panels.description: Critical threat rows not acknowledged or cleared. Streaming — turns red the instant a rule fires.
panels.viz_content: SELECT count() AS critical FROM ag.agentguard_threats WHERE severity = 'critical' AND (status = '' OR status = 'open') AND deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' SETTINGS seek_to = '-{{filter_time_range}}'

panels.title: Open warnings
panels.description: Warning threat rows not acknowledged or cleared. Streaming.
panels.viz_content: SELECT count() AS warnings FROM ag.agentguard_threats WHERE severity = 'warning' AND (status = '' OR status = 'open') AND deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' SETTINGS seek_to = '-{{filter_time_range}}'

panels.title: Live tool calls
panels.description: Streaming: every tool the agent invokes, as it happens.
panels.viz_content: SELECT event_time, tool_name, substring(tool_input, 1, 120) AS input FROM ag.agentguard_cim_event WHERE event_type = 'tool_invoke' AND deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' SETTINGS seek_to = '-15m'

panels.title: Threats over time by rule
panels.description: Security events per minute, stacked by rule. Streaming — new bars appear as rules fire.
panels.viz_content: SELECT window_start AS time, rule_name, count() AS events FROM tumble(ag.agentguard_security_events, detected_at, 1m) WHERE deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' GROUP BY window_start, rule_name SETTINGS seek_to = '-{{filter_time_range}}'

panels.title: Attack chain by session
panels.description: probe → injection → credential access → exfiltration, per session (1 = stage observed). Streaming — stages light up live.
panels.viz_content: WITH staged AS (SELECT event_time, session_id, agent_id, multi_if(event_type = 'tool_complete' AND tool_name IN ('WebFetch','WebSearch'), 'probe', event_type = 'tool_complete' AND (lower(tool_result) LIKE '%ignore previous instructions%' OR lower(tool_result) LIKE '%ignore all previous%'), 'injection', event_type = 'tool_invoke' AND match(lower(tool_input), '(credentials|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\\.env\\b|private key)'), 'credential_access', event_type = 'tool_invoke' AND match(lower(tool_input), '\\bcurl\\b.*(--data|-d @|--upload-file)'), 'exfiltration', '') AS stage FROM ag.agentguard_cim_event WHERE deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') SELECT session_id, max(stage = 'probe') AS probe, max(stage = 'injection') AS injection, max(stage = 'credential_access') AS credential_access, max(stage = 'exfiltration') AS exfiltration, min(event_time) AS first_seen, max(event_time) AS last_seen FROM staged WHERE stage != '' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 20 SETTINGS seek_to = '-{{filter_time_range}}'

panels.title: Tool-call rate vs trailing baseline
panels.description: Calls per minute against the trailing mean and mean + 3σ of the previous hour.
panels.viz_content: WITH per_min AS (SELECT to_start_of_minute(event_time) AS m, count() AS calls FROM table(ag.agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type = 'tool_invoke' AND event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m), raw AS (SELECT m AS time, calls, avg(calls) OVER (ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN 60 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS base, stddev_pop(calls) OVER (ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN 60 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS sd FROM per_min), banded AS (SELECT time, to_float64(calls) AS calls_v, if_not_finite(base, to_float64(calls)) AS baseline, if_not_finite(sd, 0.0) AS sd FROM raw) SELECT time, 'calls' AS series, calls_v AS value FROM banded UNION ALL SELECT time, 'baseline' AS series, round(baseline, 1) AS value FROM banded UNION ALL SELECT time, 'upper (mean + 3σ)' AS series, round(baseline + 3 * sd, 1) AS value FROM banded ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Events per minute by agent type
panels.viz_content: SELECT window_start AS time, agent_type, count() AS events FROM tumble(table(ag.agentguard_cim_event), event_time, 1m) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' GROUP BY window_start, agent_type ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top tools
panels.description: Most invoked tools in the selected time range.
panels.viz_content: SELECT tool_name, count() AS calls FROM table(ag.agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_type = 'tool_invoke' AND event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Open threats by severity
panels.description: Streaming count of open threats by severity.
panels.viz_content: SELECT severity, count() AS threats FROM ag.agentguard_threats WHERE (status = '' OR status = 'open') AND deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' GROUP BY severity SETTINGS seek_to = '-{{filter_time_range}}'

panels.title: Recent threats
panels.description: One row per (agent, session, rule); folded by mv_threats. Streaming — new threats appear live.
panels.viz_content: SELECT last_seen, severity, rule_id, rule_name, agent_id, session_id, if(status = '', 'open', status) AS status FROM ag.agentguard_threats WHERE deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 25 SETTINGS seek_to = '-{{filter_time_range}}'

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Per session: first/last event, tool calls, threats.
panels.viz_content: SELECT e.session_id AS session_id, any(e.agent_id) AS agent_id, min(e.event_time) AS first_seen, max(e.event_time) AS last_seen, count_if(e.event_type = 'tool_invoke') AS tool_calls, any(t.threats) AS threats FROM table(ag.agentguard_cim_event) AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, count() AS threats FROM table(ag.agentguard_threats) GROUP BY session_id) AS t ON e.session_id = t.session_id WHERE e.event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND e.deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}' GROUP BY e.session_id ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 20

viz_config.mdString:
**Claude Code hooks → `ag.agentguard_hook_events` → CIM normalizer MVs → `ag.agentguard_cim_event` → rule MVs (`mv_rule_*`) → `ag.agentguard_security_events` → `mv_threats` → `ag.agentguard_threats`**

Every rule is a `CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW … AS SELECT … WHERE …`. Pause one with `SYSTEM PAUSE MATERIALIZED VIEW ag.mv_rule_rp002`.

Demo rules: `demo-001` indirect prompt injection in tool results · `demo-003` outbound data transfer · `demo-chain` probe → injection → exfiltration in a 10-minute session window · `demo-004` tool-call burst.

App: github.com/timeplus-io/apps/tree/main/apps/agentguard
